# Route inventory (generated by `gateway/tools/route_inventory.mjs`; do not edit by hand)

Target for every route below: **api.mac-guard.com**, served by the single Worker `macguard-gateway` (a modular backend, not one service per hostname). Current host: `quarantine-api.mac-guard.com` (see DOMAIN-ARCHITECTURE.md). Quarantine routes are NOT in this table: they belong to the Quarantine Worker and keep `panel.` / `quarantine-api.`. DNS: one new record for `api` at cutover (Custom Domain), nothing else. D1 migrations: `0001` and `0002` before the code that needs them.

## Per area: function, dependencies, risk, smoke test, rollback

| Area | Function | Dependencies | Risk | Smoke test | Rollback |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| health | liveness | none | none | GET /v1/health -> 200 over TLS | redeploy previous version |
| community | Community index and redirect helpers | GitHub Releases (public), D1 for best-effort counts only | must never fail because telemetry or D1 is down; must not be rate limited | GET /v1/community/releases/<tag>/download -> 302 to the public asset; 400 on a bad tag | redeploy previous version; the public GitHub URLs never depended on it |
| intel | Intelligence REST (hash, CVE, IOC, enrich) | D1 (records, quotas, ledger) | licence gate must hold; quotas atomic | GET /v1/intelligence/hash/<sha256> without key -> 401 | redeploy previous version |
| premium | Premium catalogue and authorised download | D1 + private R2 bucket (binding PREMIUM) | R2 private; one-time bound token; licence gate | GET /v1/premium/releases without key -> 401 | redeploy previous version |
| download | Signed download transfer (Range) | D1 + R2 | token reuse/sharing; partial transfers | GET /v1/dl/<token> without key -> 401 | redeploy previous version |
| account | Tenant self-service (usage, entitlements, analytics, commercial terms, checkout) | D1; Stripe only for checkout (not configured) | tenant id only from the key | GET /v1/account/usage without key -> 401 | redeploy previous version |
| mcp | MCP server (stateless, revision 2026-07-28) | same pipeline as REST | body size, Origin check | GET /mcp -> 405; POST without key -> 400/401 | redeploy previous version |
| webhook | Stripe webhook | D1 (event-id dedupe); STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRETS (not configured) | replay, forged events, oversize bodies | POST /stripe/webhook unsigned -> 400/503 | redeploy previous version; remove the webhook endpoint in Stripe |
| x402 | x402 pay-per-request (experimental, OFF) | facilitator (none) | must stay disabled | GET /x402/anything -> 404 | n/a |
| admin-policy | Commercial policy: propose, approve, apply, rollback | D1 | changing the commercial mode; Cloudflare Access recommended in front | GET /admin/v1/policy without credentials -> 401 | POST /admin/v1/policy/rollback |
| admin-analytics | Analytics API, dashboards, reports, costs, CRM, exclusions, forced GitHub sync | D1; GitHub API for the sync | cost/CRM data is commercially sensitive | GET /admin/v1/analytics/kpis without credentials -> 401 | redeploy previous version |
| admin-tenants | Tenants and API-key lifecycle | D1 (KEY_PEPPER secret) | a new key is shown once; audit chain | GET /admin/v1/tenants without credentials -> 401 | revoke the key / suspend the tenant |
